translations.web: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.
translations.bsb: But I will establish My covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.
translations.kjv: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives
